title: The Gates of Ashenmoor
text:
*The road to Ashenmoor stretches before you like a scar across the land. Grey dust clings to your boots, and the air carries the faint taste of copper and old smoke.*

The city gates loom ahead — massive iron-bound doors set into walls of blackened stone. A line of weary travelers shuffles forward under the watchful eyes of guards in tarnished armor. Above the gate, carved in weathered letters: *Ashenmoor Endures.*

*You have traveled far to reach this place. The sealed letter in your pack speaks of disappearances, of a city rotting from within. Three merchants vanished in a fortnight. The Duke's own envoy found dead in a ditch. Whatever waits beyond these gates, there is no turning back now.*

The guards are checking papers with deliberate slowness. You study the gate and consider your approach.

choices.text: Stride to the front and present your credentials with authority
Slip away from the line and look for a less watched entrance
Shoulder your way to the front — you've waited long enough
Wait patiently and listen to the other travelers' conversations
